source_ref: Centro de Investigaciones Sociológicas (CIS), Estudio 3212 'Barómetro de la vivienda y el alquiler' (questionnaire header 'BARÓMETRO SOBRE LA VIVIENDA Y EL ALQUILER', clave ECIS3212), abril-mayo 2018, N=2468. Study page https://www.cis.es/es/estudios/barometro-de-la-vivienda-y-el-alquiler ; microdata https://www.cis.es/documents/20117/1556711/MD3212.zip (md5 5a417629c8c4f949310a16543727cf75) containing ES3212 (SPSS syntax: DATA LIST, VARIABLE LABELS, VALUE LABELS; sha256 3069ae2547f29520d767815a365910c5c91a37bd955dde1f3a622f9b41f7a4a3), DA3212 (fixed-width data, the processing script's input; sha256 599956f66133c76542f88c045eb6c92e8f0f0c7d740c013fcbafd234672d0ede) and cues3212.pdf (questionnaire, sha256 5fb29cc83ccd7f44acf168edefbe6b3ae2ae2d1512c4a09da5be0822d010f20c, byte-identical to the standalone https://www.cis.es/documents/20117/1556711/cues3212pdf.pdf), P.6; marginals https://www.cis.es/documents/20117/1556711/es3212marpdf.pdf (Pregunta 6). Processing script data/spain_2018_housing.do, Table 3: amenities. Reuse terms https://www.cis.es/es/condiciones-reutilizaci%C3%B3n-datos-del-cis
note: mapping_basis=data_labels. DERIVATION is core model s3 pattern 1: data/spain_2018_housing.do infixes DA3212 at the ES3212 DATA LIST positions (P6_1..P6_6 = cols 52-57, identical to ES3212) and Table 3 sets item = the literal CIS variable name (P6_1..P6_6, case kept) -- nothing positional, so Step 5b is exempt and no verification_/verify_ files were written. LABELS: ES3212 VARIABLE LABELS P6_1 'Cocina independiente', P6_2 'Aire acondicionado', P6_3 'Línea fija de teléfono', P6_4 'Acceso a Internet', P6_5 'Garaje', P6_6 'Trastero' -- 6/6 character-identical to the six row labels of the P.6 grid in cues3212.pdf (which prints the tag [P6] under the stem) and to the marginals' Pregunta 6 rows; asserted by exact match in .cache/spain_2018_housing_amenities/build.R. VALUE LABELS identical on all six: 1 'Sí' 2 'No' 9 'N.C.' (no N.S. category), matching the grid header 'Sí No N.C.'. CHECKED ANYWAY, decisive: reading DA3212 (2468 records, all 395 bytes; id = row number) at cols 52-57, dropping 9 as the .do does, with cov_sex col 210 and cov_age cols 211-213 (99 -> NA), reproduces the live table exactly: 14799 rows both (= irw_table_sets n_rows 14799), 2467 ids, 0 only-live / 0 only-rebuilt rows, 0 resp / cov_sex / cov_age mismatches. Live item x resp (1 Sí / 2 No): P6_1 2397/70, P6_2 1112/1355, P6_3 1980/487, P6_4 1920/547, P6_5 1104/1362, P6_6 1077/1388 -- six distinct Sí counts, so the count match itself distinguishes every item from every other, and they equal the marginals' Pregunta 6 Sí percentages over N=2468 (97.1, 45.1, 80.2, 77.8, 44.7, 43.6). Content is coherent (a separate kitchen near-universal, air conditioning/garage/storage room under half). Dropped to missing by the .do: N.C. 1/1/1/1/2/3. Both levels used by every item. Live values read from the local irw cache copy table_context.R wrote (no extra export). TEXT (text_source=study_materials): instructions = the P.6 stem '¿Dispone la vivienda de…?' verbatim from cues3212.pdf, keeping its single ellipsis character (the marginals print '...' with three full stops); it is the shared grid stem, so it goes in instructions, section_prompt is blank and there is one trivial section_id. The preceding P.5 lead-in ('Vamos a hablar ahora de las características de la vivienda...') belongs to P.5 (dwelling size, not an IRW item here) and was not shipped. item_text = the terse grid row labels; option_text = 'Sí'/'No'. language=Spanish; translation_source=machine_translation: CIS publishes Estudio 3212 in Spanish only, so the four _translated fields were written by IRW and an issues-page entry is owed once live. STEP 3b: dictionary Description 'Services available in the dwelling' matches P.6 exactly; the .do's comment names P6_1..P6_6 and live has exactly those six codes and resp {1,2}. No instrument mismatch. SIBLINGS: spain_2018_housing_building and _dwelling (this round) and the later-round tables were not touched; all scratch under .cache/spain_2018_housing_amenities/. RIGHTS: no block. Applied the existing instrument_rights_register.csv CIS row (line 117, verdict allow, every CIS survey year, irw#2381); the originator of the wording is CIS. Reuse page re-fetched 2026-09-25 (HTTP 200, sha256 7c824dd59133f32998eae7f7285ae720c86c8d4889a135b50111849b21e90036; session-varying by design) and the operative clauses re-found: 'para fines comerciales y no comerciales' and 'cesión gratuita y no exclusiva'. No register row written.
public_note: The English in the _translated columns was machine-translated by IRW from the Spanish CIS administered (CIS publishes this questionnaire in Spanish only).

source_ref: Centro de Investigaciones Sociologicas (CIS), Estudio n 3212 'Barometro sobre la vivienda y el alquiler', abril-mayo 2018 (2,468 interviews). Study page https://www.cis.es/es/estudios/barometro-de-la-vivienda-y-el-alquiler ; microdata deposit https://www.cis.es/documents/20117/1556711/MD3212.zip (md5 5a417629c8c4f949310a16543727cf75) containing fixed-width DA3212, SPSS syntax ES3212 (VARIABLE LABELS and VALUE LABELS) and 3212.sav; questionnaire https://www.cis.es/documents/20117/1556711/cues3212pdf.pdf (md5 54343bca0cc096e049047abd7edc3cfb, byte-identical to cues3212.pdf inside the zip), P.12 and P.13. Processing script data/spain_2018_housing.do, Table 5: building. Reuse terms https://www.cis.es/es/condiciones-reutilizaci%C3%B3n-datos-del-cis
note: mapping_basis=data_labels: ES3212's VARIABLE LABELS (and 3212.sav's variable labels, identical) tie each column to its item: P12 'Satisfaccion con el edificio en que se encuentra la vivienda', P13_1 'La estetica del edificio', P13_2 'El estado de conservacion', P13_3 'La accesibilidad para personas con movilidad reducida (...)', P13_4 'El aislamiento contra el calor y el frío' (accented in the label, unaccented in the questionnaire, see below), P13_5 'El aislamiento contra el ruido', P13_6 'La seguridad contra robos', P13_7 'La seguridad contra incendios' -- 8/8 match the questionnaire's P.13 row labels in printed order, and the build script asserts each one. VALUE LABELS for all eight: 1 'Muy satisfecho/a' 2 'Bastante satisfecho/a' 3 'Poco satisfecho/a' 4 'Nada satisfecho/a' 8 'N.S.' 9 'N.C.', matching the questionnaire's printed codes; codes 8/9 are dropped to missing by the .do file, so resp 1-4 ship. DERIVATION is core model s3 pattern 1: the .do file infixes DA3212 at the ES3212 DATA LIST positions (P12 col 71, P13_1..P13_7 cols 72-78) and does gen item = the literal variable name, so the IRW code IS the source column name -- Step 5b exempt. CHECKED ANYWAY: reading DA3212 (2,468 records) at those columns and dropping 8/9 reproduces the live item x resp table cell for cell (e.g. P12 899/1346/193/30, P13_3 434/776/631/611, P13_7 271/1314/458/149; source N.S. counts P13_6=87, P13_7=270), against the locally cached live copy table_context.R had already fetched (19,307 rows, 2,468 ids) -- no new export. validate_items.R --table-sets passed (8 items, resp 1-4). Structure: P.12 is a standalone question (section _1, blank section_prompt, full question in item_text); P.13's shared stem is the section_prompt of section _2 and its seven row labels are the item_text. instructions blank: no text frames both questions. Literal transcription from the questionnaire PDF (pdftotext); the questionnaire prints 'el frio' without the accent in P13_4 while the ES3212 and .sav labels read 'frío' -- shipped as printed in the questionnaire, not corrected. The '/su vivienda' and '/de su vivienda' alternates are the interviewer's printed alternative wording for respondents in a detached house and are kept as printed. text_source=study_materials: Spanish from CIS's own questionnaire; translation_source=machine_translation: English in the _translated columns produced by IRW, CIS publishes no English questionnaire. Step 3b: dictionary Description 'Satisfaction with residential building aspects' matches P12/P13 exactly; no instrument mismatch. Siblings (amenities, dwelling, etc.) not touched. RIGHTS: no block. The wording's originator is CIS, a Spanish public body; its reuse conditions (fetched 2026-09-25, page sha256 ce1c51f11a1ac2c7ce407558c182b842cd453ade2cf5c4f4e2a4f167662f68d5) state 'Las presentes condiciones generales permiten la reutilizacion de los documentos sometidos a ellas para fines comerciales y no comerciales.' Conditions are attribution, non-alteration and no claim of official status, none a reserved right of the irw#1945 kind. No instrument_rights_register.csv row written.
public_note: Each question also had 8 'N.S.' (don't know) and 9 'N.C.' (no answer) codes that the IRW processing script drops to missing (270 N.S. on fire safety, 87 on burglary security); the English in the _translated columns was produced by IRW, not by CIS, which publishes this questionnaire in Spanish only.

source_ref: Centro de Investigaciones Sociológicas (CIS), Estudio 3212 'Barómetro sobre la vivienda y el alquiler' (convenio Ministerio de Fomento), abril-mayo 2018, 2,468 CAPI interviews. Study page https://www.cis.es/es/estudios/barometro-de-la-vivienda-y-el-alquiler ; microdata https://www.cis.es/documents/d/guest/md3212 (MD3212.zip sha256 af10cf6165098a4c7410946f529e73b71d4f14a995f6765db431afe6311ca4f5) containing ES3212 (SPSS syntax, sha256 3069ae2547f29520d767815a365910c5c91a37bd955dde1f3a622f9b41f7a4a3), DA3212 (fixed-width data, sha256 599956f66133c76542f88c045eb6c92e8f0f0c7d740c013fcbafd234672d0ede), cues3212.pdf (questionnaire, sha256 5fb29cc83ccd7f44acf168edefbe6b3ae2ae2d1512c4a09da5be0822d010f20c) and 3212.sav; P.9. Processing script data/spain_2018_housing.do, Table 4: dwelling.
note: mapping_basis=data_labels: ES3212's VARIABLE LABELS tie each column to its aspect -- P9_1 'El estado de conservación', P9_2 'El tamaño', P9_3 'La distribución interior', P9_4 'La luz natural con la que cuenta', P9_5 'La orientación', P9_6 'Las vistas' -- and the shipped item_text equals those labels character for character, 6/6 (asserted in .cache/spain_2018_housing_dwelling/build.R); cues3212.pdf P.9 [P9] prints the same six grid rows in the same order. VALUE LABELS (identical for P9_1..P9_6): 1 'Muy satisfecho/a' 2 'Bastante satisfecho/a' 3 'Poco satisfecho/a' 4 'Nada satisfecho/a' 8 'N.S.' 9 'N.C.'; the questionnaire grid headers are the same four labels (with 'Bastante satisfecho/a' line-wrapped), so option_text uses them. DERIVATION is core model s3 pattern 1: the .do infixes DA3212 at the ES3212 DATA LIST positions (P9_1..P9_6 = cols 60-65, identical to ES3212 line 5) and item = the source variable name -- Step 5b exempt, no verification row or verify_*.R. CHECKED ANYWAY (rebuild, decisive): reading DA3212 (2468 records, all 395 bytes; id = row number) at cols 60-65, dropping 8/9 as the .do does, with cov_sex col 210 (1 Hombre/2 Mujer) and cov_age cols 211-213 (99 -> NA), reproduces the live table exactly: 14771 rows both (= irw_table_sets n_rows 14771), 0 rows only-rebuilt / 0 only-live, 0 cov_sex and 0 cov_age mismatches; 2467 live ids (one of 2468 respondents answered 8/9 on all six). Live item x resp (1/2/3/4): P9_1 781/1398/248/38; P9_2 860/1354/234/19; P9_3 787/1435/216/28; P9_4 971/1224/238/34; P9_5 893/1287/221/46; P9_6 680/1051/554/174 -- every item uses all four levels, so every used level has an option row. TEXT (text_source=study_materials): instructions = the P.9 stem verbatim from cues3212.pdf (pdftotext -raw), including its single-character ellipsis '…' before '?'; the stem is shared by all six grid rows, so it is instructions, section_prompt blank, one trivial section. No show card for P.9 in tarjetas3212.pdf. No filter printed for P.9 (asked of everyone). translation_source=machine_translation: CIS publishes Estudio 3212 in Spanish only; the _translated columns were written by IRW. RESP: the .do drops 8 N.S. and 9 N.C. to missing: N.S. 2/0/1/0/20/6 and N.C. 1/1/1/1/1/3 on P9_1..P9_6 (P9_5 'La orientación' has the most, 21 of 2468, 0.9%). STEP 3b: dictionary Description 'Satisfaction with aspects of dwelling' matches P.9 exactly; no instrument mismatch. SIBLINGS (amenities, building this round; measures/neighborhood/opinions/ownership/problems/rentals later) not touched; all scratch under .cache/spain_2018_housing_dwelling/, microdata fetched independently. RIGHTS: no block; applied the existing instrument_rights_register.csv CIS row (line 117, verdict allow, every CIS survey year, irw#2381); the originator of the wording is CIS. No register row written.
public_note: The English in the _translated columns was machine-translated by IRW from the Spanish CIS administered (CIS publishes this questionnaire in Spanish only); 'don't know' and 'no answer' (at most 23 of 2,468 respondents per item) are dropped to missing by the IRW processing script.
